paragraphs: WYGS Ltd provides trusted solar PV, battery storage and heat pump installations across Huddersfield and West Yorkshire. We take the time to understand your energy goals and design a solution that delivers maximum savings and long‑term reliability.

The Warm Homes: Local Grant (WHLG) is a government initiative in England aimed at improving the energy efficiency of homes that are not connected to the mains gas grid.

Warm Homes: Social Housing Fund Wave 3 supports landlords to upgrade inefficient homes with insulation, low‑carbon heating and energy‑saving measures, improving comfort and cutting bills for residents.

Labour’s Warm Homes Plan proposes upgrading millions of homes with insulation, heat pumps and energy‑saving measures, cutting bills and improving comfort while accelerating the UK’s shift to clean heat. Due to be launched late 2026.
Founded in 2014 by Glenn and Dave, WYGS Ltd has grown from a grant‑delivery specialist into one of the region’s leading experts in
solar panels, battery storage, air‑source heat pumps and EV charging solutions
. With decades of industry experience, the team now delivers cutting‑edge renewable technologies that help homeowners reduce bills, lower carbon emissions and upgrade their homes for the future.
WYGS provides a complete range of modern renewable energy services, specialising in
solar panels, battery storage systems, air‑source heat pumps and EV charger installations
. We support homeowners, contractors and local authorities with high‑performance, future‑ready energy upgrades that lower bills and improve efficiency.
